verdict.rationale: Orb documents its own managed daily data exports of resource types to a destination of the user's choice, plus revenue exports for financial systems, so a first-party export capability exists. The evidence does not show that all data is covered, which file formats are used, or any offboarding path. List APIs with pagination are only developer building blocks and earn no credit. missing for 10: confirmation that exports cover all account data, documented open export formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet), explicit account-exit/offboarding guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Orb supports managed, daily exports of resource types to your data destination of your choice.
Track recognized and deferred revenue with exports for financial systems.
